other_provider: Switching providers in a running Agent isn't available yet
other_engine: Switching from {from} to {to} needs a new conversation
model_fixed: {agent} can't change the model of a running session
pending_note: Switches on your next message: the Agent restarts on {provider} and keeps this conversation
switch_scheduled: Switch scheduled: your next message moves the Agent to {target}
engine_note: Switching engines rebuilds context and may lose content
switch_scheduled_engine: Switch scheduled: will change to {agent} · {model} when your next message is sent
engine_dialog_body: The new Agent engine continues through a handoff summary, so reasoning and other content cannot be guaranteed to carry over perfectly; switching back still lets you continue the original engine's session. Switching also interrupts the prompt cache once and may increase token usage.
effort_next_turn: Thinking effort changes apply to the next turn, without interrupting the current turn.
effort_offline: This session is offline. Reopen it to change thinking effort.
effort_parent: The parent Agent controls this session's thinking effort.
effort_read_only: This session is read-only. Change thinking effort in the app that owns it.
effort_model_fixed: This model does not offer adjustable thinking effort.
effort_terminal: This Codex session has no shared control connection. Change thinking effort in its terminal.
